summary: First-build full test of Petra. Backend: 15 pytest tests across account/positions/trades/decisions/pnl/market/config/agent-cycle/risk-gate/pause/close/chat — 15 passed, 0 failed. Real Claude LLM calls verified via /agent/run-cycle and /chat streaming. Frontend: dashboard root loads, all 6 metric ribbon cards populated, equity chart renders, positions table + close buttons present, RUN AGENT CYCLE triggers a real cycle and produces new verdict cards, all 3 bottom tabs switch, RISK modal opens and Save persists, Ask Petra chat streams a coherent multi-position reply from Claude. Risk-gate correctness verified: all approved decisions honor max_risk<=cap and credit/width>=min; rejected decisions include at least one failing gate check.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {error: 'position not found or already closed'} for invalid IDs instead of 404. Minor REST semantics.
force defaults to True (payload.get('force', True)); design decision but note that omitting force still forces — spec suggested force=true is explicit.

issues: Tab labels 'OPEN POSITIONS DESK', 'RISK GATE AUDIT', 'TRADE HISTORY' visually overlap with the underlying table header row below (stacking/z-index/margin). See /app/test_reports/dashboard_after.png. Non-blocking but looks cluttered.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (console warning). Accessibility polish only.

action_items: Fix visual overlap between bottom tab bar and trade-history table header (design polish).
Optionally return HTTP 404 for close-position with unknown id instead of 200+error field.
Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Risk modal to remove Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /positions/{id}/close returns 200 for not-found; prefer HTTPException(404).
server.py agent_run_cycle default force=True — arguably risky; consider default False and let UI pass force=True explicitly (frontend already does).
engines.py build_spread forces contracts=1 even when risk_budget cannot afford it — relies on risk_gate to reject; acceptable but worth a code comment.
server.py account() computes day_pnl using day_start_equity from account doc; make sure it is reset on new trading day (not verified here).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds via seed_demo() at startup; existing seed used (18 closed trades, ~2 open positions, equity ~$112k). Tests do not create/modify seeded fixtures beyond one open-then-close cycle and a temporary config change (restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env, all routes under /api. Real Claude LLM is called by /api/agent/run-cycle and /api/chat — allow 60-120s timeouts. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist (loadscope) so TestPositionClose may skip when TestAgentCycle running in parallel consumes/creates positions — re-run standalone with -p no:xdist -o addopts='' if needed (verified passing that way). No auth. All Alpaca calls mocked.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only cosmetic overlap in Trade History tab area — likely a missing margin/padding or absolute-positioned tab bar overlapping content wrapper. Reproduction: open dashboard, click 'TRADE HISTORY' tab; observe tab labels overlap first row header. Mitigation: give the tab bar container a solid background and margin-bottom, or ensure the tab list is not overlaying the scroll region.
